name: Boosteroid
requires: A Boosteroid account with a subscription
pitch: Play your Boosteroid games on your PS3.
description: Sign in to Boosteroid with a QR code on your phone, then browse and search the games in your Boosteroid library. Play them on the PS3 (Project DeepWater 00.72 and on): Start + Select leaves a game, L3 + R3 is the Xbox button. Not made by or affiliated with Boosteroid. Built on what the open-source ZERODROID client worked out.
whatsNew: A new look, Boosteroid's own: the game in focus fills the screen, with PLAY and Add to my games, then My games, the whole Catalogue by genre and order, and Search, on wide cards (needs Project DeepWater 00.73).
